name: Nekoyashiki Persia
source:
Favorite Food: pasta
Skills: acting, singing, dancing

A friend of Mike’s who comes from a rich family.

Usually refined and elegant, she has a mischievous side to her, too. She has a motherly nature and also ends up falling for our helpless protagonist. Not long after, she decides to confess.

But she does this at the exact same time as Mike and Ameri...
